title: CareConnect
summary: A ten-screen mobile UI concept that helps a parent manage everyday medication and check-ins while family caregivers receive clear, permission-based updates.
status: Concept/prototype; not a production healthcare app
conceptGoal: Help a parent manage familiar daily care tasks while letting family caregivers stay informed through clearly controlled sharing.
designObservations: Two related experiences: parent and caregiver
Large, clearly labelled touch targets and legible typography
Soft, reassuring surfaces with strong readable text
Permission settings that clarify what is shared

caseStudySections.heading: Everyday warmth, designed for care
caseStudySections.body: Daily care can involve medicine schedules, check-ins and communication across a family. CareConnect explores a calmer, more approachable way to bring these small tasks together.

caseStudySections.heading: Two sides of one caring experience
caseStudySections.body: The concept includes separate parent and caregiver flows. Parents see simple daily actions and decide what to share. Caregivers can review updates and, where permission is provided, help manage medicine plans.

caseStudySections.heading: Clarity in the details
caseStudySections.body: A soft iris-and-lavender palette, readable Atkinson Hyperlegible Next typography and generous touch targets give the interface a gentle, accessible-feeling visual direction.

caseStudySections.heading: From screens to interactions
caseStudySections.body: An offline HTML prototype demonstrates navigation and selected confirmation, sharing, reminder and help flows. It uses illustrative data and simulated actions; it is not a production care or emergency service.

disclaimers: Do not claim clinical validation, usability testing, measurable impact, real users or deployed product performance.
Do not describe simulated calls, alerts or account verification as functional services.
